title: Insufficient Calibration dead-end on G6
symptom: After fitting a new Dexcom G6 sensor and entering the calibration code, readings were inaccurate. After entering a calibration, no more readings were received, and the phone showed 'insufficient calibration' with the calibration button disabled. Attempting to reset calibrations did not restore the calibration option, leaving the user unable to calibrate because the sensor is not taking readings.
cause: The thread suggests that xDrip does not work correctly with the Dexcom G6 on certain phones, possibly due to Bluetooth compatibility issues, and recommends disabling the 'Use the OB1 Collector' setting to resolve the issue.
fix: Disable the 'Use the OB1 Collector' setting in G5/G6 settings, wait 5 minutes, and the sensor should be picked up. This workaround is also suggested for the 'stopped sensor' error.
evidence_quote: you need to disable in G5/G6 settings, "Use the OB1 Collector" - see my screenshot. Wait 5 min and it will pick up your g6 sensor guaranteed.
